Parameters ---------- username : str The user's name as entered. bio : str A user-written biography that may span multiple sentences. status_message : str A brief, current status message provided by the user. Returns ------- str The profile HTML string with all user-provided content escaped. Raises ------ TypeError If any argument is not a string. """ # Validate input types if not isinstance(username, str): raise TypeError("username must be a string") if not isinstance(bio, str): raise TypeError("bio must be a string") if not isinstance(status_message, str): raise TypeError("status_message must be a string") # Escape all user input to prevent XSS safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(bio, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status_message, quote=True) # Format the profile using the predefined template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, bio=safe_bio, status_message=safe_status )
